note: Read 2026-11-03 in the University of Minnesota Human Rights Library's copies of the laws, each naming the issue of the Official Gazette it reproduces (the State's laws database at the National Information Centre, yemen-nic.info, doesn't answer this client), marked secondary. Majority: 15. The Civil Law (Republican Decree-Law No. 14 of 2002, Official Gazette issue 7/1 of 2002), art. 50: the age of majority (سن الرشد) is fifteen full years; a person who reaches it of sound mind and prudent in their dealings has full capacity to exercise and dispose of their civil rights, and special laws may require a higher age (none held). Work: null here; the person research's working age (fifteen, under Ministerial Decision No. 11 of 2013 as WageIndicator summarises it, research/sources/person/ages/YE.json) and its reading that no exception lets a younger performer work are read from that file (tools/papers/ages/person.ts). The Child Rights Law (No. 45 of 2002, Official Gazette issue 22 of 2002), art. 133, read the same day, bars all work under fourteen and industrial work under fifteen: the floor the 2013 Decision keeps beside its fifteen, and not held over the later Decision. Whether either law was amended after 2002 wasn't checked. Service: not read.
